Word Woods audio credits

The story sentences, whole-word narration and four guide prompts were
generated with ElevenLabs, then levelled for tablet speakers. The game
plays bundled MP3s. The victory fanfare is original music for Readling.
https://elevenlabs.io

The letter sounds, slow blending models and fallback word recordings use
the sources below.

The letter shelf uses short sounds from Curious Learning's Feed the Monster
Australian English recordings. That pack also supplies cat, mat, bug and pig.
Hen comes from the project's US English recordings. The published English
adaptation credits Curious Learning, building on the original Feed the Monster
project by Apps Factory, CET and the International Rescue Committee.

Audio sources and attribution notice
https://github.com/curiouslearning/ftm-languagepacks/tree/7be4c9c922a6266b11f3f7821bb8ca6574f2cacd/AUSTRAILIANENGLISH/sounds
https://github.com/curiouslearning/ftm-languagepacks/tree/7be4c9c922a6266b11f3f7821bb8ca6574f2cacd/USENGLISH/sounds
https://github.com/curiouslearning/FeedTheMonsterJS#contributing

Curious Learning identifies the audio as Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY).
The source pack also carries the BSD 2-Clause notice reproduced below.
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/

Hat, dog, cup and sun are by Judith Franck and Association Shtooka, recorded
in British English. Their recordings are used under CC BY 3.0 US.
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/us/
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:En-uk-hat.ogg
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:En-uk-dog.ogg
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:En-uk-a_cup.ogg
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:En-uk-sun.ogg

Pot is by Commander Keane, recorded in Australian English. This recording,
including both adaptations bundled with Word Woods, is shared under
CC BY-SA 4.0.
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:En-au-pot.ogg
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

Pen and log are from Art4Apps (Smart4Kids.com, 2011), distributed by
GCompris. The original recordings are marked Creative Commons
Attribution-ShareAlike. The normal and slowed clips are also distributed
under that licence.
https://github.com/gcompris/GCompris-voices/blob/master/en/words/pen.ogg
https://github.com/KDE/gcompris-data/blob/master/voices/en_GB/words/log.ogg
https://github.com/gcompris/GCompris-voices/blob/master/LICENSE
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/

Edits for Word Woods include cropping, adjusting playback level, fading
clip boundaries and converting the audio to MP3. Some consonant endings
were shortened. The slow blending models each use one continuous word
recording, stretched in time while preserving pitch.

The audio studio also includes a longer take of b from the same Australian
English recording. Its full spoken release is retained, with the surrounding
silence trimmed. The studio identifies any replacement the owner selects.
